name: tracker-loop
enabledWhen: queue non-empty (the bot pauses it when the queue is empty and resumes it on a new request)
prompt:
Work only in <wt> for fleet files. First read template/rules/common.md, manager/overrides.md, manager/local/*, manager/roles/worker.md, bots/<me>/rules.md, then bots/<me>/state.json (all under that worktree), and follow them.

Then pull <queue-clone> (your private queue repo <queue-repo>) and check every open request in queue.json (a JSON array) in one pass. Carrier requests: public tracking pages/endpoints; if the carrier blocks scripted access, also do a read-only email search for carrier/merchant delivery notices for that tracking number and count a delivered notice as Delivered. Email requests: read-only search. Update checkCount/lastStatus/updatedAt (<timezone>). End any request that hit its expected status, maxChecks or expiresAt: report the result (final status, check count, why it ended, plus any found value) to its requester bot(s) only, as a priority message; remove it, and put id, requester and result in the commit message. Commit and push only if the file changed. If the queue is empty, pause this routine. Stay silent otherwise. Never message the user directly.
